distortion_reading: the emitted form is stretched ~12.4% widthwise relative to the accepted fixture proportions — NOT visually equivalent, merely curve-preserving

visible_effects.shoulder: vertical compression flattens the shoulder curve; the soft M3 transition reads slightly sharper and wider
visible_effects.neck: the neck flare under the collar widens proportionally; the collar-seat junction reads more pronounced than the fixture
visible_effects.body: overall silhouette reads squatter/wider; the fixture's slender serum character is diluted at 35x95

policy_proposal.state: PROPOSED — production remains PROFILE_AUTHORITATIVE until the owner selects a mode

PROFILE_AUTHORITATIVE.behavior: confirmed width/height exact; M3 curves deform anisotropically (CURRENT production behavior)
PROFILE_AUTHORITATIVE.risk: M3 character drifts whenever confirmed aspect diverges from 3.079; no guardrail

M3_CHARACTER_AUTHORITATIVE.behavior: uniform scale preserving aspect 3.079; confirmed height honored, width DERIVED (30.9 mm at H=95)
M3_CHARACTER_AUTHORITATIVE.risk: violates the confirmed width — requires an owner dimension amendment before use

BOUNDED_M3_ADAPTATION.behavior: anisotropic mapping permitted while the distortion ratio stays within tolerance; beyond it the reconstruction REFUSES with M3_PROPORTION_OUT_OF_BOUNDS and asks the owner to either amend dimensions or explicitly select PROFILE_AUTHORITATIVE
BOUNDED_M3_ADAPTATION.tolerance_basis: 5% anisotropy — the threshold below which curve character is generally imperceptible; anchored to the VQ-1 acceptance discipline (sub-1% residuals) with a 5x allowance, NOT chosen to pass current output
BOUNDED_M3_ADAPTATION.honesty_note: the CURRENT production output (ratio 1.1245) would FAIL this tolerance; under this mode the 35x95 profile requires either width <= 32.4 mm (ratio 1.05) or an explicit PROFILE_AUTHORITATIVE selection

policy_proposal.recommendation_reason: keeps confirmed dims authoritative inside a perceptual guardrail and turns large divergence into an explicit owner decision instead of a silent squash
